answer: An farming party as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The cipher counter is kept in prism and umber shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 325 aliases cost 256 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
